title: Kya sitam muslime bekas pa hua koofe me
body:
Kya sitam muslime bekas pa hua koofe me
<<DIVIDER>>

<<MINI>>
Kya sitam muslime bekas pa hua koofe me
<<DIVIDER>>
1) Kaisi ye naayabe shabbir pa hoti hai jafa
Koi imdaad ko aaye to zara koofe me
<<MINI>>

2) Ek muslim ke muqaabil me hai lashkar saara
haaye mehmaan pa hoti hai jafa koofe me
<<MINI>>

3) Rehgaye masjide koofa me akele muslim
Saath haq ke na kiya koi wafa koofe me
<<MINI>>
Kya sitam muslime bekas pa hua koofe me
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Kya qata hai mere muslim ki ye batla zaalim
Aayi ye faatima zahra ki sada koofe me
<<MINI>>
Kya sitam muslime bekas pa hua koofe me
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Ghar se bulwaake dagha de gaye ahle koofa
kuch bhi aayi na inhe sharmo hayaa koofe me
<<MINI>>
Kya sitam muslime bekas pa hua koofe me
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Koun hai jo dare koofa se nikaale sar ko
Nouha ye zoujaye muslim ne kiya koofe me
<<MINI>>
Kya sitam muslime bekas pa hua koofe me
<<DIVIDER>>
7) Nouha ye rouzaye muslim par sunaana hyder
hoga maatam ka ye kohraam bapa koofe me
